scope: Current local mathematical sources, explicit review scopes, executed finite checks, compilation and visual inspection. Remote saving is verified separately after this file is committed.
reference_review: asz4 main and its canonical-four proof were checked at the recorded commit in this update. Other recorded reference commits remain the source points for unchanged results; the full source repositories are not duplicated.

mathematical_review.moduli_foundations: Root proof and independent review of the fpqc stacks, finite-window quotient presentations, regular normal cubic incidence, strict 2-fibres, tangent space and commutative fibre over nonreduced bases. No finite-type claim for the full inverse limit.
mathematical_review.categorical_comparison: Independent review of strong arrows, compatible 2-arrows, vertex scalar crossed module, pointed rigidification and relative line-bundle descent. Saturation, relative Hom base change and categorical reconstruction remain explicit hypotheses.
mathematical_review.period_forgetting: Review of the period groupoid, finite-type two-factor stabilizer reduction, twisted conjugacy and finite additional Zhang identifications. The new integer certificate establishes finite generic two-factor stabilizer, not its order.
mathematical_review.indexed_normal_rigidity: Root and independent review of the full indexed normal incidence over graded Artin ambient deformations, including a possibly nonflat relative stabilizer. Centralization and the strict four-dimensional formal fibre follow. No periodization of arbitrary Z ambient families is inferred.
mathematical_review.relative_nakayama: The relative Koszul-dual Frobenius structure now follows from the relative bar lemma under componentwise local freeness. The relative bimodule Nakayama construction and its explicit dual formula remain stated inputs of the existing rigidity proposition.
mathematical_review.formal_ambient_comparison: Root and independent checks of the finite Beilinson window, projective frame slice, minimal hull comparison and the actual Qmod natural transformation at the commutative P4 point. This is a set-valued isomorphism-class Artin comparison; no higher-groupoid equivalence is asserted.
mathematical_review.formal_component_image: Independent review of the 37-dimensional formal component and the codimension-zero formal image after completion along the whole commutative ambient fibre. Flat completion, proper base change and formal functions apply. This is not a claim at one fixed cubic or on the smooth-proper subfunctor.
mathematical_review.cubic_artin_map: The actual envelope morphism and its tangent formula are identified. The 17-dimensional cubic Artin model uses the manuscript's homogeneous formality input. Compatibility of independently chosen formality coordinates in all orders is unproved.
mathematical_review.inherited_results: Unchanged previously checked mathematical results and calculation certificates are retained. Their code hashes were checked unchanged, but the eight older computations were not rerun in this update; older proofs did not receive an exhaustive new audit.
mathematical_review.novelty: Literature inputs and supplied proofs are separated. Priority and exhaustive novelty verification remain incomplete.
mathematical_review.p3_frobenius_potential: Root and independent checks of Frobenius-period normalization, the vertex sign correction, 4-CY rolling, signed quartic potentials and second path derivatives. The field normalization was compared with asz4; BSW primary text was checked.
mathematical_review.relative_bar_and_pointed_stack: Root and two independent readings of the finite internal-degree bar complex, arbitrary-base-change compatibility, perfect Frobenius pairings, infinite affine fpqc frame cover, scalar correction and the PGL4^4 pointed-stack equivalence. Strict Z-stack and bare category moduli are not identified.
mathematical_review.p3_formal_determinantal_model: Root and independent checks of the all-Artin rank-six theorem: positive Koszul truncation contains only previously free degrees, H_1 identifies with the quadratic quotient degree, and the bimodule complex is exact and self-dual. Scheme-theoretic minors, not only fibre ranks, are required.
mathematical_review.standard_n_and_p4: The same trace, bar and descent proof was checked for standard N-dimensional binomial Koszul AS families. N=5 gives [U5^AS/PGL5^5], with U5^AS a subfunctor of P3124. Five rank-ten 25x125 flattenings give the commutative-point Artin model. No direct numerical tangent-matrix computation was performed for N=5.
mathematical_review.cubic_p3_comparison: Root and independent checks of the Rees-lemma index 2, Hilbert-series proof of infinite projective dimension, the commutative cubic HH_1=HH_-1=k^5 obstruction to ordinary tilting, compact dg generation, and the scope of Orlov/CCKM/Kuznetsov primary results.
mathematical_review.recent_literature: BSW, Mori-Nyman, Pym and the 2025/2026 Frobenius-moduli/discrete-invariant preprints were compared at the primary-text level. The cusp counterexample to an unrestricted tangent-isomorphism component criterion is recorded in the notes; the affected criterion is not used as an input.
